results.title: China-aided Laos' first integrated photovoltaic-storage-charging 'zero-carbon library' opens
results.description: HANGZHOU, CHINA, Sept 2, 2026 - ( JCN Newswire ) - Laos' first zero-carbon library, built with support from Zhejiang Electric Power Corporation, officially opened at Luang Prabang Peace Secondary School on August 29. The library integrates solar power, energy storage and charging facilities, bringing a green energy solution to the school.
